title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper: no real orders are placed anywhere in it. The snapshot below was read from the engines' own state at 2026-11-04T20:26:14.690Z. It reports what is open, what has closed, and what the market filter is doing now. One trade says nothing about a strategy, and the live sample is small.

## Open positions

- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper. It has 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 1 position open on paper: HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z. It has 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade.
- NEAR: an entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.

The open count is a state reading, not a forecast. Nothing here says whether an open position will close today or later. Paper means the engines record signals; no account is credited or debited by these entries.

## Most recent closed trade

- ATOM: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. It exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703. That result is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 each show 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade.
- htf-rsi-v007 shows 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade.

A closed trade records what happened to that signal. It does not by itself establish that the rule behind it is sound or unsound. The ATOM trade is the first live signal in this record, so it is also the first closed result.

## Market filter and breakout distance

- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is on.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is on.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high; XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high; BCHUSDT is 7.26% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high; HYPEUSDT is 5.29% below its high; XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high.

These distances are measurements against each coin's high. They are not entry signals and they are not price targets. A filter being on is a status, and a distance below a high can change with the next daily close.

## Live starts and framing

- v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026.
- v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026.
- The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close.
- In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.
- Framing: paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

The live record began recently, so the closed-trade counts are small. The averages are descriptions of what has happened so far, not estimates of future results. The testing figure is a historical summary, not a live result.

## Where to check

- The record updates continuously.
- The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.
- This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-04T20:26:14.690Z.

The page and log are the places to verify any figure used above. The channel status repeats the same counts and prices, so the record can be checked in more than one place.
